name: suzukua IPTV EPG (XMLTV)
license: The upstream repository's MIT LICENSE applies to its software, not necessarily third-party EPG listings/channel data; data licensing and redistribution rights are not explicitly established.
notes: The project page reports automated updates at least twice daily and provides t.xml plus t.xml.gz. Direct XML endpoint returned HTTP 200 application/xml; bounded first 65,536 bytes begin with XMLTV <tv>. Separately, the complete gzip artifact was parsed as XMLTV: root <tv>, 129 channels and 36,167 programmes. No channel mapping or client EPG import test was performed.

name: EPG.pw China XMLTV Guide
license: Public guide endpoint; explicit licensing/redistribution terms for the aggregated listings were not confirmed. Use as a remote client feed only after reviewing the provider's current terms.
notes: The original awesome-tvbox list identifies this as the China XMLTV endpoint. Full GET and XML parse checked 2026-11-24: HTTP 200 text/xml; XMLTV root <tv>, 711 channel records and 39,814 programme records (feed date 2026-11-24; 9,898,167 bytes). This large feed is not mirrored here. Channel-name mapping and client EPG import were not tested; it may contain channels unrelated to a user's playlist.

name: EPG.pw Hong Kong XMLTV Guide
license: Public guide endpoint; explicit licensing/redistribution terms for aggregated listings and channel logos were not confirmed. Use as a remote client feed only after reviewing the provider's current terms.
notes: The provider lists Hong Kong as a guide region. Full GET and XML parse checked 2026-11-24: HTTP 200 text/xml; XMLTV root <tv>, 236 channel records and 47,438 programme records (feed date 2026-11-24). This is a large live feed and is not mirrored here. Channel-name mapping, logo reuse rights and client EPG import were not tested; the guide may contain channels unrelated to a user's playlist.

name: IPTV-org Channel Logo Library (API)
license: iptv-org/api code is Unlicense/public-domain; iptv-org/database README displays CC0 for its database project. Neither statement establishes reuse rights for each third-party channel logo image. This is a link-only index, not an assertion of logo reuse rights.
notes: API index of channel and feed logos, including image URL, in-use flag, dimensions and format. The upstream API documents logos as sourced from iptv-org/database and offers a JSON endpoint. Checked 2026-11-24: endpoint returned HTTP 200 and JSON records; no logo assets are mirrored. Match `channel` / `feed` identifiers against a playlist before use; not every live playlist channel is guaranteed to have a corresponding logo. Client integration and logo rights require separate review.
